summary: Full-stack regression for the rebuilt RIYANMEE PROXY (HNPROXY V3 style). Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass against public preview URL — auth (register 201 + duplicate 409 + demo login + /me protected + change-password 400), profile whitelist (add/invalid 400/duplicate 409/remove), reset-traffic, /my-ip, ip-info (valid geo via ipwho.is + invalid 400), hunt for all 4 modes returns 12 real-geo proxies + invalid 400, history sort-desc + clear + auth-guard. Frontend E2E on 390x844 web preview: login (demo) -> dashboard renders username idmee, PREMIUM MEMBER, countdown '30H 12J 45M 54D', server/port, whitelist add+remove, Whitelist My IP prefill (104.198.214.223), change-password modal opens; go-hunting card -> Hunting screen, mode modal picks FULL SCAN, 'Mulai Pencarian' returns 12 proxies (proxy-item-0..11 all render with San Jose/Google LLC for 8.8.8.8), 'Salin Semua' shows '12 proxy disalin' toast; Cek IP for 1.1.1.1 -> Brisbane/Australia/Cloudflare Inc/AS13335; Riwayat lists 2 entries and clears; Logout returns to login; Direct /beranda without session correctly redirects to /login; Register flow creates FREE MEMBER (e2e_<ts>) and auto-logs in. No red console errors were captured during the flow.

ui_bugs.issue: In the mobile viewport, the modal card is tall enough that 'pw-cancel-button' / 'pw-save-button' sit below the visible fold and Playwright reports 'Element is outside of the viewport' when scrollIntoView is attempted. Real users on ~390x844 must scroll inside the modal to reach the buttons. Consider wrapping modal content in a ScrollView or reducing vertical padding so the action row is reachable without scrolling. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/beranda.tsx around the sheet layout.

issues: Copy toast overlaps the target-IP input for a moment ('12 proxy disalin' banner sits on top of alamat IP field). Non-blocking, purely cosmetic.

action_items: (Nice to have) Make the change-password modal scrollable or shorter so pw-cancel/pw-save buttons are reachable on 390x844 without extra scrolling.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~470 lines and still mixes helpers + routes; fine for current scope but consider splitting if it grows.
Frontend `.env` exposes only `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL`; tests fall back through EXPO_BACKEND_URL / EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL to support both.
Auth flow correctly stores JWT in secure storage under `riyanmee_token` and hydrates via /auth/me on load; guard behavior verified (direct /beranda -> /login redirect works).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for all seven requested E2E flows (login, register, dashboard, hunting, cek IP, riwayat, logout, guard redirect)

seed_data_creation: Backend seeds demo user 'idmee' idempotently at startup. Test run created transient users test_regr_<ts> and e2e_<ts>; residual only if user runs again without DB reset (usernames are unique).
